descriptions.text: Enchanted Silver Bracelet of the Ab-solar. "AnD SO The lioN fEll iN lOVe WiTh The LaMB." I'm actually quite fond of the Twilight novels. Plus, I would never stoop so low as to disparage the work of an over-imaginative and obviously undersexed artist who managed to become a brazilianaire from barely-disguised erotica targeted at adolescent girls. However, I would like to take this opportunity to point out that your culture's obsession with fictional, underaged heroes was absolutely misguided. …

recap.text: Donut equips the sparkling bracelet from her Apothecary gold box, its purple gems shaped like garlic bulbs, and all four of her legs are full. Carl's patch from the Plenty gives the same protection, and Mordecai grunts that the two sponsors are working together. Miriam Dom calls for help at sunset; Mordecai says to let her die and take her gear in the morning, but Carl grabs the sewing kit, since she saved his life.

beats.headline: Purple, like garlic
beats.text: Carl's gold box from the Plenty gives a patch; Donut's gold box from the Apothecary gives a sparkling bracelet, and she equips it at once. The obsidian Fireball bracelet moves to her right foreleg, this one goes on the left, and with the fallen oak anklet and her plus-two dexterity bracelet on the back legs, all four legs are full. She loves it, though the description sounds like the AI is having a stroke. Its purple gems are shaped like bulbs of garlic. It protects against vampirism and lycanthropy, with plus 25 percent magical damage against sapient undead. Carl's patch gives the exact same benefits. Mordecai grunts: the two sponsors really are working together.
beats.gist: Donut equips a sparkling bracelet with garlic-shaped purple gems, and Carl's patch gives the same vampire protection.

beats.headline: A vampire, by coincidence
beats.text: Miriam Dom is trapped and asking for help as the sun sets. Mordecai suggests letting her die and collecting her gear in the morning. Two different sponsors who know more than they do just spent a huge amount of money to protect them from vampirism, he says, and by coincidence a vampire shows up asking for help. She saved my life, Carl says, grabbing the sewing kit. If it's a trap to turn them into vampires, they will be protected.
beats.gist: Miriam Dom begs for help at sunset; Mordecai suspects a trap, but Carl takes the sewing kit anyway.
